name: musicfree-pad
description: MusicFree Pad 版 - 运行在 iPad / Android 平板等大屏移动设备上的音乐播放器，核心功能与 MusicFreeDesktop 对齐，数据/插件互通

scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -derivedDataPath /tmp/mfp-ios-dd build
scripts.ios:device: npm run cap:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'id=00008027-000D58E11184002E' -derivedDataPath /tmp/mfp-ios-dd -allowProvisioningUpdates build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008027-000D58E11184002E /tmp/mfp-ios-dd/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 00008027-000D58E11184002E com.huah.musicfree.pad
